# Q-049: 100.00 USD bought into Wise USD, recorded at 137.00, for 140.00 CAD
# out of Chequing, the 3.00 between them on a `$residual$` split. In a book
# that keeps no cost bases a realized difference is what the file states, so
# the 3.00 is stated as realized, whichever way the USD split moves; a file
# meaning a bank charge gives it an amount of its own.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_a_book_can_keep_no_cost_bases.py.
